item.title: Google Chrome silently installs a 4 GB AI model on your device without consent
item.description:
📝 The file is named weights. Chrome does not surface it. If the user deletes it, Chrome re-downloads it.
🔗 Read more: https://www.thatprivacyguy.com/blog/chrome-silent-nano-install/

item.title: The Frog for Whom the Bell Tolls
item.description:
📝 The video starts by mentioning “Frog Game” instead of the actual first Zelda game on the Game Boy: Link’s Awakening. I’ve since played Frog Game and I recommend the game as a quick and fun “pocket-sized” adventure. Frog Game references Nintendo very directly multiple times.
🔗 Read more: https://sethmlarson.dev/the-frog-for-whom-the-bell-tolls
